name: West Shore Home Field at Beaver Stadium

bagPolicy.summary: The stadium permits clear totes up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches and small wristlets up to 5 × 8 × 1 inches. Medical, dietary and childcare bags receive separate inspection at ADA entrances near Gates A and B.
allowed: Medical, dietary or childcare bag after inspection
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: For the 2024 Luke Combs concert, Penn State directed concert parking to Lots 26 and 36. Parking assignments for future concerts must be checked against that show’s instructions.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue has not published a general concert rideshare pickup location in its stadium A-Z guide.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Food and beverage concession stands operate inside the stadium; selection and prices vary by event.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The stadium A-Z guide identifies ADA entry near Gates A and B, accessible parking shuttles near Gate B and on Porter Road near Gate A, and nursing pods near the Mount Nittany Club and Gate F.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The stadium A-Z guide prohibits re-entry after leaving; Penn State also applied this rule to its 2024 Luke Combs concert.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The venue has not published a general concert will-call pickup time or window in its stadium A-Z guide.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: For the 2024 Luke Combs concert, entry used Gates A, B, E and F and the South Tunnel. Check the current concert page for its entrances and door time.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
